exact_directed_L3.extension: For this directed U(1) q=1 channel only, for p>1/2 replace p by 1-p using j->1-j, which shifts the observed charge and relabels logical parity.

exact_directed_L3_full_interval_attempt.extension: For this directed U(1) q=1 channel only, for p>1/2 replace p by 1-p using j->1-j, which shifts the observed charge and relabels logical parity.

honeycomb.claim: Under exact interior charge and binary logical scoring, q=1 honeycomb Bayes LER decays exponentially for every p in [0,1], for any fixed edge arrows. Analytic path bound plus rigorous honeycomb connective constant; no corresponding all-p square claim.
